visual.general_description: Combined line chart and timeline for the index patient with a left axis for anti-NMDA receptor antibody titer, a right axis for mRS, treatment markers above the plot, annotated vertical lines, and care-location bars below.
visual.detailed_description: A white-background figure. Above the plot, three rows of colored circular markers carry boxed labels: "rituximab" (magenta markers, six), a boxed label that renders as "IVIG" or "MG" at this resolution (brown markers, five) and "bortezomib" (orange markers, six); marker positions follow the x-axis below, with later markers in the months section. The left y-axis is labeled "Anti-NMDA titer 1:y" with printed ticks 0, 5.0x10^3, 1.0x10^4, 1.5x10^4, 2.0x10^4 and 2.5x10^4; the right y-axis is labeled "mRS" with ticks 0 to 5. A red line with circle markers is labeled "NMDA R antibody titer serum", a blue line with square markers "NMDA R antibody titer CSF" and a thin olive line "mRS" (legend box at lower left). The red serum line starts with a steep fall, then runs fluctuating with a few isolated spikes, one in the weeks section and one in the months section, ending lower. The blue CSF line has few markers joined by long straight segments. The olive mRS line is flat, then steps down twice. Annotated vertical lines and arrows carry the texts "resection of the right ovary", "cyclo-phosphamide", "resection of the left ovary", a dashed span labeled "daratumumab" and "rehabilitation program". The x-axis is split into a weeks section (printed ticks 0, 2, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 13, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22, 26, 28, 30, 31, 32, 34, 35, 37, 38, 39, 41; axis title "weeks") and, after a break, a months section (ticks 10, 12, 13, 14, 18, 19, 21, 27; axis title "months"). Bars beneath the axis are labeled "Iraq", "secondary care center Germany", "University hospital Germany", "Intensive Care Unit", "Intermediate Care Unit" and "Normal Ward"; short bracket marks in the months section carry no text. No patient name, date or institution logo is visible.

evidence.quote:
Figure 2
Phenotyping lymphocytes before and after daratumumab treatment. Peripheral blood lymphocytes were analyzed by flow cytometry 2 days before (A,B) and 12 days after daratumumab (C) has been administered. Due to prior rituximab application CD20/CD19high B cells were lacking. Cells were first gated on singlet lymphocytes according to their FSC vs. SSC properties and then analyzed in the gates indicated on the top of each dot plot. Dots stained positive in the CD19+CD38+ gate are shown emphasized for better visibility. (D) Depict data obtained during cytometric rituximab monitoring showing the absence of any CD19+ cells at the indicated time points after first daratumumab application.
fulfilling the marker criteria of plasma cells/plasmablasts in peripheral blood (Figures 2A,B)

assignments.rationale: Caption and text place panels A and B in the index patient peripheral blood before daratumumab.

Figure 2
Phenotyping lymphocytes before and after daratumumab treatment. Peripheral blood lymphocytes were analyzed by flow cytometry 2 days before (A,B) and 12 days after daratumumab (C) has been administered. Due to prior rituximab application CD20/CD19high B cells were lacking. In addition, the nearly comlette absence of CD19+ cells confirms at least a complete plasmablast depletion for nearly 1 year after starting daratumumab therapy (Figure 2D).
